summary: Comprehensive functional baseline audit of the confirmed repository scope; this was not a diff review. Two medium-impact contract and edge-case defects were identified.

findings.title: Long but valid custom scripts fail after the paid attempt is marked submitted
findings.problem: Custom brief validation permits up to 400 script characters but does not limit word count. More than 80 words makes minimum_duration exceed the renderer's 30-second maximum, so jingle_duration throws before Speech synthesis (and also breaks offline rendering). For paid renders the route has already marked the attempt submitted, then records failed_or_unknown; the user must reconcile an attempt for which no provider request was made and cannot retry until then.
findings.suggested_fix: Reject or otherwise handle scripts whose required duration exceeds 30 seconds during brief validation or estimate/preflight, before reserving and marking a paid attempt submitted.

findings.title: The output Pass state cannot be reached through supported application flows
findings.problem: output_status returns Pending unless every component status is exactly Pass. Rendered components are always created as Pending or Recorded basis; human review required (see apps/api/src/render.ts:97-109 and the composition component records), and no application route or UI action records a component review. Consequently, even after a successful evaluation, metering reconciliation, and numeric gates, users cannot make an output or the overall rollup reach Pass using supported flows; the documented completion status is effectively dead.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a supported, auditable human component-review action that persists the review disposition and evidence as Pass only after approval, so the existing rollup gate can be satisfied.

testing_recommendations: Add a custom-brief regression test with a valid script exceeding 80 words; verify it is rejected before a paid attempt is reserved or marked submitted.
Add an end-to-end status test proving how reviewed component evidence can transition an otherwise passing output and rollup from Pending to Pass.
recommended_actions: Validate custom-render duration requirements before paid reservation.
Define and implement the supported component-review transition used by output status.
risk_assessment: Medium: the identified issues affect valid custom rendering and prevent supported completion of the output status contract; no Critical or High functional findings were identified.
